entities.name: PHONE OR COMPUTER
entities.rationale: End-user devices accessing frontend content and submitting API requests.

entities.name: CLOUDFRONT
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudFront content delivery network serving media and static assets.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket serving as origin storage for media content and processed output.

entities.name: API GATEWAY
entities.rationale: Amazon API Gateway handling REST API requests from client devices.

entities.name: LAMBDA (INGEST)
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function processing initial requests, returning playlists, and dispatching tasks to SQS queues.

entities.name: SQS (TOP)
entities.rationale: Primary Amazon SQS queue decoupling incoming requests for batch processing.

entities.name: SQS (BOTTOM)
entities.rationale: Secondary Amazon SQS queue managing task distribution to worker instances.

entities.name: EC2 AUTO SCALING
entities.rationale: EC2 Auto Scaling group processing queue messages and storing results in S3.

entities.name: STEP FUNCTIONS
entities.rationale: AWS Step Functions state machine orchestrating batch workflow steps.

entities.name: LAMBDA (STEP FUNCTIONS)
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function triggered by Step Functions to interact with the Auto Scaling group.

entities.name: CLOUDWATCH EVENTS
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudWatch Events capturing system state changes and scheduled triggers.

entities.name: LAMBDA (CLOUDWATCH EVENTS)
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function invoked by CloudWatch Events to scale or manage EC2 worker nodes.

visual_connections.description: S3 serves media assets (RaaS) to CloudFront for global distribution.
End-user devices fetch media content directly from CloudFront distribution.
Client devices send API requests to Amazon API Gateway.
API Gateway passes incoming API invocations to the primary Lambda function.
Lambda returns playlist responses directly back to client devices.
Lambda function pushes processing work items to the top SQS queue.
Lambda function dispatches secondary tasks to the bottom SQS queue.
EC2 worker instances poll and consume messages from the top SQS queue.
EC2 worker instances consume tasks from the bottom SQS queue.
EC2 instances store processed media and output files into the S3 bucket.
Step Functions orchestrates workflow state and triggers the associated Lambda function.
Lambda manages or coordinates scaling actions on the EC2 Auto Scaling group.
Lambda emits execution events into CloudWatch Events.
CloudWatch Events invokes the monitoring Lambda function based on event rules.
Monitoring Lambda function triggers adjustments or signals to the EC2 Auto Scaling group.
EC2 Auto Scaling group pushes lifecycle and operational events to CloudWatch Events.
